question: 월별 인원과 인건비
sql:
SELECT pay_month AS 월, COUNT(DISTINCT emp_id) AS 인원, SUM(amount) AS 인건비
FROM payroll
GROUP BY pay_month
ORDER BY pay_month

drill.title: 가장 최근 달 인건비의 전월 대비 증감 — 급여 항목별 × 부서별
drill.sql:
WITH m AS (
  SELECT MAX(pay_month) AS cur,
         strftime(strptime(MAX(pay_month) || '-01', '%Y-%m-%d') - INTERVAL 1 MONTH, '%Y-%m') AS prev
  FROM payroll
)
SELECT p.pay_item AS 급여항목, e.dept AS 부서,
       SUM(CASE WHEN p.pay_month = m.prev THEN p.amount ELSE 0 END) AS 전월,
       SUM(CASE WHEN p.pay_month = m.cur THEN p.amount ELSE 0 END) AS 당월,
       SUM(CASE WHEN p.pay_month = m.cur THEN p.amount ELSE -p.amount END) AS 증감
FROM payroll p JOIN employees e ON p.emp_id = e.emp_id, m
WHERE p.pay_month IN (m.prev, m.cur)
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY abs(증감) DESC

question: 월별 1인당 초과근로 시간
sql:
SELECT strftime(work_date, '%Y-%m') AS 월,
       SUM(overtime_hours) AS 초과근로합,
       COUNT(DISTINCT emp_id) AS 인원,
       ROUND(SUM(overtime_hours) / COUNT(DISTINCT emp_id), 2) AS 일인당_초과근로
FROM attendance
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

drill.title: 가장 최근 달 초과근로 시간 — 부서별
drill.sql:
WITH m AS (SELECT strftime(MAX(work_date), '%Y-%m') AS cur FROM attendance)
SELECT e.dept AS 부서,
       SUM(a.overtime_hours) AS 초과근로합,
       COUNT(DISTINCT a.emp_id) AS 인원
FROM attendance a JOIN employees e ON a.emp_id = e.emp_id, m
WHERE strftime(a.work_date, '%Y-%m') = m.cur
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 초과근로합 DESC

question: 월별 퇴사자 수 (2024-07 이후)
sql:
SELECT strftime(leave_date, '%Y-%m') AS 월, COUNT(*) AS 퇴사자수
FROM employees
WHERE leave_date >= DATE '2024-07-01'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

drill.title: 같은 기간 퇴사자 — 퇴사 사유별
drill.sql:
SELECT leave_reason AS 퇴사사유, COUNT(*) AS 퇴사자수
FROM employees
WHERE leave_date >= DATE '2024-07-01'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 퇴사자수 DESC

question: 공고 유형별 채용 기간
sql:
SELECT opening_type AS 공고유형,
       COUNT(*) AS 채용완료_공고수,
       ROUND(AVG(close_date - open_date), 1) AS 평균_채용기간_일,
       MEDIAN(close_date - open_date) AS 중앙값_일
FROM job_openings
WHERE status = '채용완료'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1
